safety_verdicts.content: The headache has not awakened the patient from sleep.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention whether headache awakens her from sleep.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a headache wakes a patient from sleep is a secondary-headache red-flag screen; omitting it can reduce diagnostic confidence and may delay escalation if the headache has concerning features. In this case the history notes onset on waking, but does not clarify being awakened by pain, so the record remains incomplete.
